interpretation_boundary: This is a construction-control test conditional on the observed H2-selected species. Failure means that the recurrent axis can be reproduced after preserving the frozen coarse-state composition and its global palette mapping, so it cannot be presented as species-specific continuous geometry beyond state construction. Passing does not by itself establish an ecological mechanism.

primary_0_10.null_definition: Within each cohort and each frozen coarse morph state, permute normalized 9-colour palette rows across the already-selected H2 species while preserving every species x coarse-morph row count; then refit label-free Hellinger two-means. This preserves the global coarse-state-to-palette mapping and H1 state composition but destroys species-specific continuous palette structure.
